Senses.Explanation: The Essential Collection of the Linked Lamps is a lamp-history title, not a teaching phrase. Its own title heading names the work, while later lineage biographies repeatedly say that Huiweng Wuming compiled it and transmitted it in the monasteries. Those biographies use the book as evidence of a master's editorial work and the continuation of recorded lineages; parallel retellings of that fact do not create additional senses.
